# Shipped-image and artifact provenance

This table defines build recipes and selection rules. Per-build SHA-256 values are retained in the evidence location named by each row; generated outputs are not assigned static hashes. Raspberry Pi boot firmware is an external platform/HIL prerequisite rather than a repository-produced image, so its exact revision and hashes belong in retained HIL evidence.

| Artifact | Platform | Status | Format | Producer | Output / identity | Selection rule | Immutable inputs | Hash evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AArch64 virt root filesystem | AArch64 virt | experimental | ext2 disk image | `scripts/run-virt.sh` | `DISK_IMAGE reported to scripts/run-virt.sh by its aarch64 image-assembly invocation` | build.rs output path reported through a unique AXIOM_ARTIFACT_PATHS file | Cargo.lock; rust-toolchain.toml; userspace/file_structure; ci/manifests/components.toml; AXIOM_BPF_TRUSTED_KEY_PATH trust root | SHA-256 printed by scripts/run-virt.sh before QEMU launch |
| Raspberry Pi 5 kernel ELF | Raspberry Pi 5 | supported after HIL | ELF | `scripts/build-rpi5.sh release embedded-rpi5` | `target/aarch64-unknown-none/release/kernel` | fixed target, profile, package, and binary path | Cargo.lock; rust-toolchain.toml; embedded-rpi5 feature set; AXIOM_BPF_TRUSTED_KEY_PATH trust root | SHA-256 in target/aarch64-unknown-none/release/rpi5-artifacts.sha256 |
| Raspberry Pi 5 raw kernel | Raspberry Pi 5 | supported after HIL | raw kernel8.img | `scripts/build-rpi5.sh release embedded-rpi5` | `target/aarch64-unknown-none/release/kernel8.img` | llvm-objcopy of the fixed kernel ELF path | Cargo.lock; rust-toolchain.toml; embedded-rpi5 feature set; AXIOM_BPF_TRUSTED_KEY_PATH trust root | SHA-256 in target/aarch64-unknown-none/release/rpi5-artifacts.sha256 |
| Raspberry Pi 5 root filesystem | Raspberry Pi 5 | supported after HIL | ext2 disk image embedded in kernel8.img | `scripts/build-rpi5.sh release embedded-rpi5` | `DISK_IMAGE reported to scripts/build-rpi5.sh by its aarch64 image-assembly invocation` | build.rs output path reported through a unique AXIOM_ARTIFACT_PATHS file | Cargo.lock; rust-toolchain.toml; userspace/file_structure; ci/manifests/components.toml; AXIOM_BPF_TRUSTED_KEY_PATH trust root | SHA-256 in target/aarch64-unknown-none/release/rpi5-artifacts.sha256 |
